lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gills, arranged in visible vertical columns of approximately 3 to 4 nodes across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal carinae and high-luminance blobs to form a rectangular coordinate-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges extending along the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete, small high-luminance blobs scattered across the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration observed toward the posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple commensal fish (remoras) clustered near the ventral surface and trailing the pectoral fin.
